newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Telecom listing depends on market conditions.
newsitem.headline: Korea Telecom listing depends on market conditions.

text.p: South Korea will not press ahead with a plan to list state-run Korea Telecom on the local stock market unless the market's condition improves, a senior official at the Finance and Economy Ministry said on Monday.
"We will not go ahead with the listing plan if the stock market remains as it is," Kim Yoo-suk, a ministry director-general, told reporters.
Kim said the ministry would take steps to "absorb shocks", even if market conditions improved to allow the listing of the company.
Kim was responding to a report by Yonhap Television News that finance minister Kang Kyong-shik had confirmed the company would be listed by June as originally planned.
He said the steps that could absorb shocks would include the raising of the foreign share ownership ceiling.
The foreign ownership limit is due to rise to 23 percent this year from the current 20 percent.
